text: 工业和信息化部、财政部、国家税务总局联合发布通知，明确了2026年度享受增值税加计抵减政策的先进制造业企业名单制定工作的相关事项。通知指出，先进制造业企业需在2026年内具备高新技术企业资格，并且2025年期间研发支出、研发人员、高新技术产品占比需符合相关规定。同时，企业需满足制造业销售额占比50%以上等条件，并确保在申请名单前36个月内未发生骗取退税或虚开增值税发票等行为。
text_en: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Finance, and the State Taxation Administration jointly issued a notice, clarifying matters related to the formulation of the list of advanced manufacturing enterprises eligible for VAT additional deduction policies in 2026. The notice states that advanced manufacturing enterprises must have high-tech enterprise qualification within 2026, and during 2025, R&D expenditures, R&D personnel, and the proportion of high-tech products must meet relevant regulations. Additionally, enterprises must meet conditions such as manufacturing sales accounting for more than 50%, and ensure no fraudulent tax rebates or false issuance of VAT invoices occurred within 36 months before applying for the list.
